en.title: Habits in the past
en.summary: Used to and would describe repeated actions in the past.

paragraphs: English has two ways of saying that something happened regularly in the past but no longer happens: used to and would. Used to describes habits and states. Would describes only repeated actions.

items: Every summer we **would visit** my grandparents.

paragraphs: Used to is followed by the base form. It has no present form; for the present, use the present simple with an adverb such as usually. In questions and negatives, the auxiliary did carries the tense, and the spelling becomes use to.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementHe used to smoke.
questionDid he use to smoke?
negativeHe did not (didn't) use to smoke.
stateThere used to be a cinema here.

paragraphs: Would describes a repeated action in the past, but not a state. It needs a context that already shows the time is past, such as when I was a child. You cannot say I would be shy. Say I used to be shy.

blocks.html:
Meaningused towould
repeated actionWe used to play outside.We would play outside.
stateShe used to be shy.not possible
single eventnot possiblenot possible

Past (finished)Present
I used to run every day.I run every day.
She didn't use to like coffee.She doesn't like coffee.
Did you use to live here?Do you live here?

items: Wrong: **I used to going.** Right: **I used to go.** (but: I am used to going means something different)
Wrong: **Did you used to go?** Right: **Did you use to go?**
Wrong: **I would live in Rome.** Right: **I used to live in Rome.**

ro.title: Obiceiuri în trecut
ro.summary: Pentru obiceiuri și acțiuni repetate în trecut, limba română folosește timpul imperfect.

paragraphs: Vorbim despre acțiuni pe care le făceam des în trecut. Aceste acțiuni erau obiceiuri, dar nu se mai întâmplă acum. Limba română nu are un verb ca „used to”. Româna folosește timpul imperfect pentru aceste situații.

Imperfectul se formează prin adăugarea unor terminații la rădăcina verbului. Fiecare persoană are o formă clară. Nu avem nevoie de verbe ajutătoare. Adăugăm des cuvinte ca „mereu” sau „în fiecare an”.
